_about: Code that cannot run under test, excluded from coverage. Each entry names an anchor line (trimmed text; with "after", the first anchor line after that unique line) and excludes the brace region the anchor opens. A missing or ambiguous anchor fails the check. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can verify. See docs/TESTING.md.

exclusions.reason: Process entry point: builds the logger, calls run, and exits with os.Exit(1) on error. Exiting would kill the test binary; run itself is tested in cmd/api/main_test.go.

exclusions.reason: Forwarding a migration failure out of run needs a database that rejects migrations at startup. Migrate's own failure is tested (TestMigrateFailsOnClosedPool); this branch only returns it.
fs.Sub fails only for an invalid path; "migrations" is a constant, valid path into the embedded FS.
NewPostgresSessionLocker fails only for invalid options, and none are passed.

NewProvider fails only for a nil database, an empty or malformed migrations FS, or conflicting options; all three are fixed at compile time here, and a malformed migration file would fail TestConnectAndMigrate.
Reading the version fails only if the database drops between a successful Up and the next query; that race cannot be produced deterministically.
